NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 7th November , 2022 

S.O. 5175 ( E ) .— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , S.O. No. 3546 ( E ) dated 29 July 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 
3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and 
operation of NH - 752D ( Spur ) on the stretch of land from Km 26.9 to Km 47.4 ( Ujjain - Badnawar Section ) in the 
district of UJJAIN in the state of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Dainik Bhaskar " and " Free Press " 
both dated 04 August 2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 

And whereas no objections have been received from any person by the Competent Authority ; 

And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3873 दिनांक 17 अगस्त 2022 , जो भारत के राजपत्र , 
असाधारण , भाग II , खण्ड 3 , उपखंड ( ii ) में प्रकाशित की गई थी , द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के धार जिले में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 
क्रमांक 752 डी ( स्पर ) के कि . मी . 83.40 से कि . मी . 96.00 ( उज्जैन - बदनावर खण्ड ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण 
( चौड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने , आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 क की उपधारा ( 3 ) के अधीन तारीख " 23 अगस्त 2022 
" को " दैनिक भास्कर " और " फ्री प्रेस " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी को किसी व्यक्ति से कोई आक्षेप प्राप्त नहीं हुए हैं ; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में , केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी

की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि

से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

New Delhi , the 7th November , 2022 

S.O. 5180 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , S.O. No. 3873 ( E ) dated 17 - August - 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , 
Section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and 
operation of NH - 752D on the stretch of land from Km 83.40 to Km 96.00 ( Ujjain - Badnawar Section ) in the district of 
DHAR in the state of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Dainik Bhaskar " and " Free Press " 
both dated 23 August 2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , No objection have been received from any person by the Competent Authority ; 

Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall

etc . ) , maintenance , management and operation of NH - 31 on the stretch of land from km 853.00 to 864.00 km

Taluk : Dhubri 

Village : Chapgarh Pt - I 


And whereas no objections have been received from any person ( s ) bythe competent Authority . 

And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government . 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose .

का.आ. 5205 ( अ ) . – मोटरयान अधिनियम , 1988 की धारा 58 की उपधारा ( 3 ) एवं धारा 110 की 
उपधारा ( 3 ) ( क ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , केन्द्र सरकार इस अधिसूचना के जारी होने की तारीख से बारह 
महीने की अवधि के लिए , इकतीस अधिक आयामी खेपों का मुंद्रा पोर्ट / कांडला पोर्ट , गुजरात से एचपीसीएल राजस्थान 
रिफाइनरी लिमिटेड , पचपदरा , बाड़मेर , राजस्थान , तक सड़क मार्ग से परिवहन के लिए , जिनका अधिकतम सुरक्षित 
लदान भार / कुल सकल भार और आकार संलग्न अनुसूची में उल्लिखित है , अनुमोदन प्रदान करती है । 

अनुसूची

The transporter will obtain necessary prior permissions from the concerned departments of the State / Union 
Territory Government for the removal of any objects like hoardings , poles , signboards , transmission line 
shutdown etc. and observe such restrictions as the State / Union Territory Government / National Highway 
Authority of India may by order specify in this behalf , before the vehicles are put on road . Cost of removal 
and redevelopment of any object permitted by the State / Union Territory Government shall be borne by 
the M / s PRISM logistics Private Limited . 


The transporter will give intimation at least ten days in advance and would need to obtain permission before 
commencement of transit , from concerned authority of State or Union Territory Authorities / National 
Highway Authority of India en - route , in view of the oversized cargo . For each such movement , the timing 
should be prescribed by the concerned authority . 


If so directed by the Public works Department of a State / Union Territory / National Highway Authority of 
India , the loaded vehicles will not be allowed to pass over or under the bridges on the roads in that 
State / Union Territory and in such cases applicants will have to make their own arrangements to cross the 
rivers / drains . 


The transporter would be liable to pay such amount to the Government of State / Union Territory / National 
Highway Authority of India or any other affected person where any damage is caused to the roads or road 
structures / other road users / persons directly or indirectly due to the movement of the trailers . 

Coupling of the trailers along the length of the road will be permissible only for above movements . 

The said vehicles should be moved without any hindrance to the normal flow of traffic . 

The vehicles should display all danger flags and lights , the vehicles should be preceded and followed by a 
vehicle displaying prominently that a heavy load is passing . 

The maximum speed of the trailers for movement on the road shall not exceed 5 km / hr . 

The trailers shall be painted for the entire width by yellow and black zebra stripes on the front and rear sides 
duly marked for night time driving / parking suitably by red lamps at the front and rear and red flags on both 
the sides during day time to indicate the extreme position of the vehicle clearly . 


The transporter will ensure that road taxes have been paid , fitness certificate , insurance cover ( including Third 
Party Insurance ) , National Permit , and PUC have been obtained in respect of all the vehicles to be utilized 
during the above movement . 


No change will be made in the Registration Certificates of the Trailers and Prime Movers as they are already 
registered in the state of Andhra Pradesh , Haryana , Gujarat , Karnataka , Maharashtra and Nagaland . 


In case of issues arising of any vehicle ( s ) or part of vehicle ( s ) out sourced from other registered owners , the 
transporter shall bear responsibility for the same . 


Any issue of any nature arising during the transportation of subject consignment shall be the responsibility of 
the transporter .

NOTIFICATION 
Bilaspur, the 4th November, 2022 
Notice under Section 20E of the Railway Act, 1989 


S.O. 5207(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Railways 
(South East Central Railway), number 8.00. 3162(E), dated the 057 July, 2022 published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part-ii, section 3, Sub-section (ii), dated the 117 July, 2022 and issued under sub-section (1) of 
section 20A of the Railways Act, 1989 (24 of 1989)(here in after referred as the said Act), the Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the land in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the 
purpose of execution, maintenance, management and operation of the Special Railway Project namely “Wadsa - 
Gadchiroli New BG Rail line (49.50 KM) Project” in Gadchiroli District in the State of Maharashtra. 


And whereas, the substance of the said notification has been published in the daily local newspapers, 
namely, Mahasagar (Gadchiroli Edition) of dated 04" August, 2022 & Dhawanilahri (Gadchiroli Edition) of dated 04" 
August, 2022 under sub-section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And whereas, objections were received; Competent Authority has heard the objections and orders have 
been passed in terms of section 20 D of the said act; 


And whereas,in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Competent Authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government. 


Now therefore, upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub- section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose. 


And further, in the pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Govt. hereby 
declares that on publication of the notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the Schedule annexed hereto

पारादीप (ओडिशा) से सिलीगुड़ी (पश्चिम बंगाल) होते हुए नुमालीगढ़ (असम) तक नुमालीगढ़ रिफाइनरी लिमिटेड के 
पारादीप-नुमालीगढ़ कच्चे तेल पाइपलाइन परियोजना के तहत कच्चे तेल के परिवहन के लिए पाइपलाइन बिछाई जाए, 
जिसका कुछ हिस्सा असम राज्य मे आ रहा है; और 


जबकि केन्द्रीय सरकार को ऐसी पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए यह आवश्यक प्रतीत होता है कि उस भूमि 
में जिसके भीतर उक्त पाइपलाइन बिछाई जाने का प्रस्ताव है और जो इस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में वर्णित है, उसका 
उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन किया जाने की जरूरत है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइंस (भूमि में उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन) 
अधिनियम, 1962 (1962 का नं. 50) की धारा 3 कि उप धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, उस भूमि मे 
उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करता है | 


कोई व्यक्ति, जो उक्त अनुसूची में वर्णित भूमि में हितबद्ध है, भारत के राजपत्र में यथा प्रकाशित इस अधिसूचना 
की प्रतियाँ साधारण जनता को उपलब्ध करा दी जाने के 21 (इक्कीस) दिन के अन्दर, भूमि के भीतर पाइपलाइन बिछाये 
जाने हेतु उपयोग के अधिकार के अर्जन के विरुद्ध अपनी लिखित रूप में शिकायत, असम राज्य में नुमालीगढ़ रिफ़ाइनरी 
लिमिटेड के पुर्व उललेखित परियोजना के सक्षम अधिकारी, श्री सज्जाद आलम, असम सरकार के संयुक्त सचिव, उद्योग और 
वाणिज्य विभाग, को नुमालीगढ़ रिफ़ाइनरी लिमिटेड के परियोजना कार्यालय, 122A, क्रिस्चियन बस्ती, जी.एस. रोड, 
गुवाहाटी- 781005, असम में भेज सकते है।

का.आ. 5214 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार , राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 ( 1956 का 48 ) ( जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात् उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है ) की धारा 3 क की उप - धारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात् कि हरियाणा राज्य के फरीदाबाद जिले में फरीदाबाद - बल्लभगढ़ - बाईपास से दिल्ली - वडोदरा 
एक्सप्रेसवे NH148NA के कि.मी. 13.000 से कि . मी . 43.700 तक के भू - खण्ड के निर्माण ( चौड़ीकरण / पेव्ड शोल्डर सहित 
6- लेन का बनाना आदि ) , अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त 
वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त

आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा ।

का.आ. 5219(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान 
हो जाने के पश्चात्‌ कि गुजरात राज्य के गांधीनगर जिले में No Yet to be Assigned के कि.मी. 160.7 से कि.मी.198 
(2एनडी फ्लौरू, कलैक्टर्‌ औफस, गांधीनगर) तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (6/8 ग्रीनफील्ड एक्सप्रेसवे आदि), अनुरक्षण, 
प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, 
ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ सब्‌ डिभिशनल्‌ मेझस्ट्रेय्ट & प्रान्‍्त औफसर्‌, गांधीनगर को लिखित 
रूप मे प्रस्तुत की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत 
रूप मे या किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और 
जाँच करने के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर 
सकेगा या अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा |

20 क की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन जारी , भारत के राजपत्र , असाधारण , भाग II खण्ड 3 , उपखण्ड ( ii ) , तारीख 31 मई 2022 में प्रकाशित , 
भारत सरकार के रेल मंत्रालय ( दक्षिण पूर्व मध्य रेलवे ) को अधिसूचना संख्या का आ . 2593 03 जून 2022 द्वारा उक्त अधिसूचना से 
उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट को महाराष्ट्र राज्य के गडचिरोली जिले में विशेष रेल परियोजना अर्थात वडसा गडचिरोली ब्रॉड गेज 
परियोजना ( 49.5 कि.मी. ) के निष्पादन अनुरक्षन , प्रबंध और प्रचालन के प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी , 


- 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 क की उपधारा ( 4 ) के अधीन दैनिक स्थानीय समाचार पत्रो , अर्थात 
गडचिरोली पत्रिका ( गडचिरोली संस्करण ) तारीख 30 अगस्त 2022 एवं चौंडेश्वरी दर्शन ( गडचिरोली संस्करण ) तारीख 31 अगस्त 2022 
को प्रकाशित किया गया था । 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी को आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे ; सक्षम अधिकारी द्वारा उन आक्षेपों की सुनवाई की गयी एंव उक्त अधिनियम की 
धारा 20 घ के अनुसरण में आदेश पारित कर दिये गए हैं , 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ड़ की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अनुसरण में अपनी रिपोर्ट सौंप दी है । 


( 1 )

प्रदत्त षक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह घोषणा करती है कि उपाबद्ध अनुसूची भूमि विनिर्दिश्ट भूमि पुर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जित की 
जाएगी । 


2 


अतः यह कि केन्द्रीय सरकार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ड़ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि इस 
अधिसूचना में राजपत्र में प्रकाशित होने पर इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिश्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर केन्द्रीय सरकार में

Notice under Section 20E of the Railway Act , 1989 

S.O. 5208 ( E ) .- Whereas , by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Railways ( South 
East Central Railway ) , number S.O. 2593 ( A ) , dated the 31st May , 2021 published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , 
Part - ii , section 3 , Sub - section ( ii ) , dated the 3 June , 2021 and issued under sub - section ( I ) of section 20A of the 
Railways Act , 1989 ( 24 of 1989 ) ( here in after referred as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its 
intention to acquire the land in the schedule annexed to the said notification for the purpose of execution , 
maintenance , management and operation of the Special Railway Project namely " Wadsa - Gadchiroli New BG Rail line 
( 49.50 KM ) Project " in Gadchiroli District in the State of Maharashtra 


And whereas , the substance of the said notification has been published in the daily local newspapers , 
namely , Gadchiroli patrika ( Gadchiroli Edition ) of dated 30th August , 2022 & Chaundeshwari darshan ( Gadchiroli 
Edition ) of dated 31th August , 2022 under sub - section ( 4 ) of section 20A of the said Act ; 


And whereas , objections were received ; Competent Authority has heard the objections and orders have 
been passed in terms of section 20 D of the said act ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 20E of the said Act , the Competent Authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government . 


SI . 
No. 


Now therefore , upon receipt of the report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers conferred 
by sub- section ( 1 ) of section 20E of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose . 


1 


And further , in the pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 20E of the said Act , the Central Govt . hereby 
declares that on publication of the notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the Schedule annexed hereto 
shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances .

202, after Chapter VI and before Chapter VII, the following Chapter VIA shall be inserted, namely — 
“CHAPTER VIA 
ONLINE BOND PLATFORM PROVIDERS 
Registration of online bond platform providers. 


SIA. (7) No person shall act as an online bond platform provider without a certificate of registration from 
the Board as a stock broker under the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 
4992. 


(2) Such person shall comply with the conditions of registration and such other requirements as may be 
specified by the Board from time to time.

regulation coming into force or such other time period as may be specified by the Board, or if it has made 
an application for grant of a certificate of registration within the specified period, till the disposal of such 
application by the Board. 


Explanation. — For the purpose of this Chapter, “online bond platform provider” means any person 
operating or providing an online bond platform and “online bond platform” means any electronic system, 
other than a recognised stock exchange or an electronic book provider platform, on which the debt 
securities which are listed or proposed to be listed, are offered and transacted.”

3. Penalty for wrong answers ( in Objective Type Papers ) 

THERE WILL BE PENALTY ( NEGATIVE MARKING ) FOR WRONG ANSWERS MARKED BY A 
CANDIDATE IN THE OBJECTIVE TYPE QUESTION PAPERS . 


( i ) There are four alternatives for the answer to every question . For each question for which a wrong answer has been 
given by the candidate , one third of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty . 


( ii ) If a candidate gives more than one answer , it will be treated as a wrong answer even if one of the given answers 
happens to be correct and there will be same penalty as above for that question . 

( iii ) If a question is left blank , i.e. , no answer is given by the candidate , there will be no penalty for that question .

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 9th November, 2022 


S.O. 5210(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule for Construction of Greenfield 
Connectivity to Jewar International Airport from DND-Faridabad-Ballabhgarh Bypass KMP Link- Spur to Delhi 
Mumbai Expressway under Bharatmala Pariyojana in the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 18.900 in the 
District of Faridabad in the state of Haryana, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, District Revenue Officer, 
Faridabad in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 5216(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways

to NH-NE4 in the stretch of land from Km. 18.925 to Km. 45.400 (Maharashtra Section) in the district of Thane in the 
state of Maharashtra, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer, Bhiwandi 
Division, Bhiwandi, Thane Maharashtra in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority 
shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing 
all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by 
order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall 
be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under this notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 9th November, 2022 


S.O. 527(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building and 
maintenance, management and operation of four/Six laning of Newly proposed Banglore-Mydukuru(Kadapa)- 
Amaravathi/Vijaywada Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km 75 to Km 99 in the district of Y.S.R. 
(Kadapa) in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Joint Collector (RB & R), 
Y.S.R(Kadapa) in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either 
allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

का.आ. 5224 ( अ ) . – केन्द्रीय सरकार रेलवे ( संशोधन ) अधिनियम 2008 ( जिसे इसमे इसके पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम 
कहा गया है ) की धारा 20'ए ' के खंड ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , यह समाधान हो जाने के पश्चात की 
लोक प्रयोजन के लिए , वह भूमि , जिसका संक्षिप्त विवरण इससे उपाबद्ध अनुसूची मे दिया गया है , महाराष्ट्र राज्य के 
जलगांव जिला में " पचोरा - जामनेर का मलकापुर तक विस्तार - नैरो गेज से ब्रॉड गेज " की विशेष रेल परियोजना के 
निष्पादन , अनुरक्षण , प्रबंधन , और प्रचालन के लिए अपेक्षित है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के आशय कि घोषणा करता हूँ । 


उक्त भूमि मे हितबद्ध कोई व्यक्ति , राजपत्र मे इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन कि तारीख से तीस दिन के भीतर , उक्त 
अधिनियम कि धारा 20 घ कि उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन उपर्युक्त प्रयोजन के लिए एसी भूमि के अर्जन और उपयोग के संबंध मे 
आक्षेप कर सकेगा | 


प्रत्येक ऐसा आक्षेप , सक्षम प्राधिकारी अर्थात उपविभागीय अधिकारी पाचोरा भाग , पाचोरा जिला जलगांव , 
महाराष्ट्र को लिखित में किया जाएगा और उसके आधार उपवर्णित करेगा और सक्षम प्राधिकारी आक्षेपकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत 
रूप से या विधि व्यवसायी के माध्यम से सुनवाई का अवसर प्रदान करेगा और ऐसे आक्षेपों कि सुनवाई करने तथा ऐसी
